scope: Distinct reviewed Gawk recipes on one immutable candidate. Every current inventory input, report dependency and raw Valgrind log is verified. Historical driver versions are matched to preserved archives. The 85 focused process logs are counted once. Original failures shared with GNU, native findings, exclusions and pending inputs remain separate; full acceptance is open.

clos1way2.review: Complete original programs, configured recipe and all fixtures reviewed. Ordinary inherited descriptor reads, getline side effects, bounded pipe input, half-close diagnostics, virtual extension I/O, or comment pretty printing. Pipe data and two-second child delays are fixed. Profile11 selects pretty printing only: the reviewed GNU main.c branch skips interpret(code_block), so the example loops and stat call are printed, never executed. Original assertions pass in all four profiles. Remaining memory/descriptor findings are preserved: native shell standard-descriptor restoration, native cat cached splice pipes, or the native virtual-I/O extension descriptor probe; no strict memory-clean pass is claimed.

getlnhd.review: Original recipe and applicable source behavior reviewed. Profile5 selects only pretty printing; GNU main.c explicitly skips interpret(code_block). It has no parse-time include/load directives, so no example BEGIN/function code executes. Nonfatal3 attempts only loopback localhost port zero and checks the connection error. Getlnhd reads fixed text from a cat here-document; it performs no database operation. All four original assertion profiles pass. Native shell stdout restoration and native cat cached splice descriptors remain open in both binaries; Gawk is clean.

pty2.review: Complete original source, configured recipe and expected output reviewed. One private PTY coprocess lowercases ABCD with tr; the original od/AWK pipeline normalizes its five output bytes. No historical pty1 hang input is selected. Assertions pass in all four profiles; shell restored descriptors and native tr buffers remain open. Candidate Gawk logs are clean.

timeout.review: Complete original source, configured recipe and expected output reviewed. Two fixed private shell producers print hello, sleep one second, and print goodbye; 400 ms reads compare timeout and retry behavior. Harness enforces bounded process-group lifetime. Normal profiles pass. Instrumented native GNU and Rboxc produce the same changed retry counts because traced child startup exceeds 400 ms. All eight instrumented processes are clean, but this is an original-assertion timing limitation, not a pass.
